title: Blocking work inside async tasks
summary: Running blocking file, network, CPU, or sleep operations inside async executors without isolation.
rationale: Blocking an async worker can reduce concurrency and create latency amplification under load.

detection.notes: Look for std::thread::sleep, blocking I/O, heavy CPU loops, or sync clients inside async functions.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large inputs, high-concurrency services, build pipelines, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Use spawn_blocking, async-aware clients, bounded worker pools, or separate CPU pipelines.
remediation.tradeoffs: Offloading has scheduling overhead; reserve it for work that can actually block or monopolize executor threads.
